About the Big Shark Saturday Mellow Ride group ride

The mellow option on Big Shark's Saturday morning road ride from the Big Bend store. 28 miles, no-drop, and the group will shorten the route if it wants. Road bike or quick hybrid. Ride leaders show up when it's above 35 degrees.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
